ttl.name: Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 LH

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 LH

s3.ptxt: Secure the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH in a vise using aluminum plates.
Install the nut to the stud of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH.
Move the stud back and forth 5 times, then turn it continuously at a rate of 2 to 4 seconds per turn and measure the turning torque on the 5th turn.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH with a new one.

specitem.ptxt: No abnormal catching or play during rotation

s3.ptxt: Check that the dust boot has no cracks or grease leaks.
